description: MCP server for the iCount (Israeli accounting/invoicing) API — documents and clients, over stdio
author: davidkotler

tool_signatures.name: icount_cancel_document
tool_signatures.description: Cancel an existing document (iCount has no hard delete — this is the only way to void one).

reason.description: Cancellation reason, stored on the record

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Cancellation reason, stored on the record

tool_signatures.name: icount_close_document
tool_signatures.description: Mark a document as closed/paid, optionally linking it to base documents it settles.

basedOn.description: Base documents this closure settles, e.g. an offer this order fulfills

parameters.name: basedOn
parameters.description: Base documents this closure settles, e.g. an offer this order fulfills

tool_signatures.name: icount_convert_document

conversionType.description: A value returned by a prior call to this tool without conversionType

parameters.name: conversionType
parameters.description: A value returned by a prior call to this tool without conversionType

tool_signatures.description: Create a new client/recipient record directly, without also creating a document.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Client name
